newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian leasing firm CIL has higher '96 profits.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian leasing firm CIL has higher '96 profits.

text.p: Compagnie Internationale de Leasing CIL net profits in 1996 amounted to 1.275 million dinars, up from 1.070 million dinars in 1995, results showed on Friday.
The firm said it would pay a 0.6 dinar dividend and a 0.4 dinar super dividend per share.
Balance sheet totals for 1996 were 53.978 million dinars, the privately owned firm said. They were 42.345 million dinars in 1995.

CIL has a capital of 7.5 million dinars in which Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie holds a 10 percent stake.Italy's FIME Leasing Spa and Netherlands' FMO hold each respectively 15 and five percent. ($=1.09 dinar)
